caption_corrections: Original controller/service/repository bands are layers inside one API process, not three containers.
Candidate generation and SQL checks belong to ai_admin_service, not adaptive_engine.
Curriculum/question services do not directly call LLM: their explicit AI endpoints delegate to ai_admin_service.
Adaptive engine has no LLM or SandboxRunner dependency; these incorrect original caption claims are removed with code evidence.
60 minutes / 13 questions are baseline defaults and configured constraints, not every session duration.
